concepts.definition: How satisfied people are with a romantic relationship and how stable it is.
One partner pursues change and discussion while the other withdraws.

questions.q: Name the five strongest predictors found by Joel and colleagues (2020).
questions.a: Perceived partner commitment, appreciation, sexual satisfaction, perceived partner satisfaction and conflict.

questions.q: Why is the evidence for the C.H.A.I.R.S. and C.O.U.P.L.E. models weak?
questions.a: They have not been tested and rest on fixed gender roles, while psychological gender differences are generally small.
